name: SGGX-based Precomputed Convolution
definition: A technique to approximate the convolution of an SGGX distribution and an isotropic spherical distribution (or another SGGX) as another SGGX with the same eigenvectors, using a precomputed mapping for roughness parameters.
summary: SGGX-based Precomputed Convolution approximates microflake convolution by mapping roughness parameters via precomputed lookup tables, avoiding expensive runtime Monte Carlo integration.
